body.statement: For fixed \(p\), every deterministic \(\lambda_n>0\) with \(\lambda_n\downarrow0\), and every \(\varepsilon>0\), the admissible triangular arrays satisfy \(\sup_{(P_n)}P_n\{\|\widehat\Omega_n-\Omega_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}>\varepsilon\}\to0\), \(\widetilde\Omega_n\succ0\) on every sample, and \(\sup_{(P_n)}P_n\bigl(\bigl|n(\bar h_n-\mu_n)^\top\widetilde\Omega_n^{-1}(\bar h_n-\mu_n)-n(\bar h_n-\mu_n)^\top\Omega_n^{-1}(\bar h_n-\mu_n)\bigr|>\varepsilon\bigr)\to0\).
body.justification: Regularization makes inversion total while uniform covariance consistency guarantees that it does not alter the first-order pivotal quadratic form.
body.gap: KaidoMolinariStoye2019 uses regular estimated covariance matrices in calibrated projection; it does not establish the finite-sample totalization and uniform Slutsky equivalence needed for this primitive inversion.
body.consumer: The confidence-region implementation can return a defined answer even when a finite sample has collinear or duplicate primitive moments.
